source.title: Armagh Guardian, 20 May 1955, p. 5 ("Not a Single Contest: County and Rural Councillors Unopposed") ("The Rural Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1955: no contests; nominations received by J. A. Dawson, returning officer. Returned unopposed. No nomination; the outgoing member is deemed to be re-elected. P. Loughran: no party label printed in 1955. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Corporation West, 3 October 1946, printed 'N': Frontier Sentinel, 28 September 1946, p. 5 ("Armagh Rural Council"); Corporation West, 5 June 1958, printed 'N': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Only Rural Contest in Clady")).
